description: List the user's projects/brands and the connected social accounts you can publish to in each. Also returns needs_reconnect (expired connections: not targets until a person reconnects them in the app; name the network before publishing), media_limits per network (image bytes: bigger ones are re-encoded to fit; video bytes and seconds: a bigger or longer video is refused for that network only, with the numbers; text length), each project's lang and translates_to (linked projects in another language), and must_draft: '' = this token may publish directly; 'role' = a member or agent token: every post waits in Drafts for an owner or admin whatever draft says; 'review_mode' = the organization reviews every post. Read it before promising 'published'. Each project carries voice: the owner's playbook for that brand (audience, tone, hooks, structure, per-network versions, what it never says, verification). Read it before writing anything for that project and follow it over the general rules; when empty, offer to draft one from the brand's best posts for the owner to paste on the Projects page. And complete means every network's copy: for every account whose text_limit the body exceeds (X 280, Bluesky 300, Threads 500), its own short copy in overrides in the same create, never a cut.

project.description: Project name to scope the accounts to (optional).
